profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin
profile.summary: An accomplished and performance-driven software engineer with a strong background in software programming and development, networks, security, testing, and technical support. Extensive design/development experience in  Real-Time embedded systems  on various types of CPUs(MPU, MCU and DSP) with many OSes. Possesses a proven track record in developing various real-time embedded software systems over multiple operating systems and platforms and implementing software upgrades while keeping within budget constraints and meeting customer/marketing requirements, resolving customer issues in a timely manner.  Contributes to success by utilizing exemplary leadership, technical, analytical, and communication skills to resolve complex problems and fulfill company goals.

positions.title: Software Design Engineer
positions.description:
RTOS SDK Software Development for New Device Series, 2019-2020

•	Performed marketing requirement analysis and project planning.
•	Executed pre-silicon verification on TI QT(Simulator) and post-silicon bring-up on evaluation board.
•	Designed and developed Automotive/Industrial-embedded platform software on TI SoCs:
o	ARM’s Cortex-R5/M4 and TI’s C66x.
o	Chip functional/register level package.
o	Board support package.
o	OS abstraction layer (Baremetal and TI-RTOS).
o	OS independent devices drivers (UART, I2C, EMAC, Watchdog, etc).

positions.title: Software Design Engineer
positions.description:
Project Lead, Graphics Software Development in Catalog BU, 2015-2019

•	Ramped up on entirely new complex domain of graphics within 30 days with no prior experience on Linux Kernel.
•	Consolidated multiple graphics code bases and packages into common Linux graphics stack across catalog and automotive BUs, saving on development and maintenance costs.
•	Integrated open-source graphics applications (such as Chromium browser) into PLSDK to demonstrate SOC capabilities per market demand.
•	Provided graphics-related technical support and training to Catalog APP team.
•	 Upgraded, maintained and integrated graphics and display software stack in quarterly Linux Processor SDK for TI Sitara devices with ARM Cortex-A53/A15/A9/A8):
o	IMG-based GPU (SGX) DDK consisting of Kernel module and openGLES libraries.
o	Open-source graphics window system, Wayland/Weston.
o	C++ based graphics application framework, Qt5.
o	Open-source, multi-media streaming framework GStreamer.
o	New graphics features and demo applications per marketing requirement.


HSR/PRP/PTP Linux Project, 2017-2019

•	Served as team member for Linux and PRU firmware-based HSR/PRP solution, supporting LinuxPTP-based PTP OC/BC/TC operations on TI Sitara devices.
•	Enhanced TI CPTS-based PTP kernel driver to support PPS generation/latching functionalities, meeting customer requirements despite IP limitations.
•	Improved LinuxPTP software stack to support multi-port OC/BC with mix of SANs and DANs.

positions.title: Software Design Engineer
positions.description:
Project Lead and Architect, NetCP (Network Accelerator), 2008-2015

•	Served as project lead for firmware-based NetCP product which provided fully-offloaded 3GPP air-ciphering over IPSEC network packet processing, including classification, routing, encryption and replay protection for use by Small-Cell gateway.
•	Performed marketing requirement evaluation, analysis, and software/firmware interface definitions based on customer use cases in collaboration with IP design team.
•	Developed PRU firmware and C-based software framework running on TI C66x DSP and ARM, used to drive NetCP for packet classification, routing, encryption, authentication across all Keystone devices.
•	Created SA (Security Accelerator) driver and firmware to perform encryption, authentication, and replay protection for IPSEC, SRTP and 3GPP air-ciphering within performance budget.
•	Designed, implemented, and tested firmware and software for next-gen NetCP enhanced features, such as IP Firewall (ACL), IP fragmentation, and reassembly and egress IP processing.
•	Developed multiple new features and enhancements of PA/SA in support of product requirements from customers.
•	Created and verified SA driver of ECC-PKA module for basic/complex PKA arithmetic operations to provide SSL acceleration.

positions.title: MCU Software Group Lead
positions.description:
MCU Software Group Lead (ANSI-136 TDMA Engine Reference Platform), 1998-2000.  
Designed and developed real-time embedded software (M-Core based MCU) for SPS ANSI-136 TDMA engine.  
Created and implemented protocol engine wrapper for third party ANSI-136 (L2/L3) protocol engine.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer (Wavetek CCM), 1997-1998.  
Managed Wavetek CDMA (IS-95) handset tester software development team.  Orchestrated on-time milestone delivery for CCM software releases.

Inmarsat Mini-M VFD Chipset, 1995-1997.  
Led Mini-M VFD (voice, fax, and data) software team to develop TMS320C3x-based VFD chipsets.  Developed VFD chipsets for use at both NEC and JRC Mini-M mobile terminals.

Inmarsat M/B VFDIU Channel Card, 1994-1995.  
Developed Inmarsat M/B VFDIU Channel Card for use at Inmarsat LES (Land Earth Station) to support voice, fax, and data relay services.
